import json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
ROOT=Path.cwd();D=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_joint_operating_state_continuity_counterexamples_v1'
D.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def write(n,o):
    p=D/n
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('已有登记不可覆盖：'+str(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
previous=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_original_producer_price_full_joint_source_v1'
proposal=read(previous/'next_experiment.json')
assert proposal['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN' and proposal['experiment_id']=='E110'
for parent in proposal['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/parent['path'])==parent['sha256'],parent['path']
joint=read(previous/'全部79原期_实际价格资金订单回款库存利润与有年龄基金共同状态_v1_0_1.json')['rows']
assert len(joint)==79 and [r['economic_period'] for r in joint]==proposal['fixed_original_periods']
conditions=list(joint[0]['overlapping_joint_states_not_financial_score'])
assert len(conditions)==8 and [k[0] for k in conditions]==list('ABCDEFGH')
outcomes={
 'cash_constraint':'原应收同比>原同范围收入同比 AND 原应收回收期同比变化>0',
 'operating_recovery_with_collection':'原同范围收入同比>0 AND 原利润同比>0 AND 原应收回收期同比变化<0',
 'inventory_constraint':'原产成品库存同比>原同范围收入同比 AND 原库存周转同比变化>0'}
main={'A':'operating_recovery_with_collection','B':'cash_constraint','C':'cash_constraint','D':'operating_recovery_with_collection',
      'E':'cash_constraint','F':'inventory_constraint','G':'cash_constraint','H':'cash_constraint'}
reduced={
 'A':'当前原同范围收入同比>0 AND 当前原利润同比>0 AND 当前原应收回收期同比变化<0',
 'B':'当前原应收同比>当前原同范围收入同比 AND 当前原应收回收期同比变化>0',
 'C':'当前原利润同比>0 AND 当前原应收同比>当前原同范围收入同比 AND 当前原应收回收期同比变化>0',
 'D':'当前原同范围收入同比>0 AND 当前原利润同比>0 AND 当前原应收回收期同比变化<0',
 'E':'当前原订单水平<0 AND 当前原应收回收期同比变化>0',
 'F':'当前原订单水平<0 AND 当前原库存周转同比变化>0',
 'G':'当前原融资五日净变化<0 AND 当前原应收回收期同比变化>0',
 'H':'当前原订单月度变化>0 AND 当前原应收同比>当前原同范围收入同比 AND 当前原应收回收期同比变化>0'}
protocol={
 'study_id':proposal['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E110','registered_at':now,
 'status':'REGISTERED_LOCAL_MACRO_FACT_CONTINUITY_BEFORE_TRANSITION_COUNTS',
 'question':proposal['question'],'unit_of_analysis':proposal['unit_of_analysis'],
 'historical_research_not_independent_validation':'全部输入及后一期原经营数量此前已被研究读过；这是显式历史发现，登记只冻结本次用途与算术，不声称事前或独立验证。',
 'fixed_original_periods':proposal['fixed_original_periods'],'original_period_count':79,'original_member_count_preserved':1711,
 'original_score_dates_and_mature_pools_preserved':1212,
 'parents':proposal['parents']+[{'path':str((previous/'next_experiment.json').relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':sha(previous/'next_experiment.json')},
     {'path':str((previous/'source_gate_v1_0_1.json').relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':sha(previous/'source_gate_v1_0_1.json')},
     {'path':'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json',
      'sha256':sha(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json')}],
 'fixed_conditions':conditions,'original_joint_conditions_not_refitted':True,
 'outcomes':outcomes,'main_outcome_by_original_condition':main,'condition_price_deleted_baseline_expressions':reduced,
 'transition_horizon':'每原期严格接列表中下一原工业期和其自己原公布钟；最后原期无下一期UNKNOWN，不跳过缺项/不改窗口或原5日金融标签。',
 'timing_rule':'后一期自己的保守公布钟必须严格晚于当前原比较截止，后一期字段只进入历史结果列；不进入当前条件或当前基金/订单/融资背景。',
 'scope_rule':'当前和下一期原收入范围、原应收范围、原库存成本范围都相同才比较三经营方向；跨范围或缺字段/无下一期/钟不后于当前均UNKNOWN，不找再后一时期替代。各原累计同比只取原报告的符号/定义，不减原绝对额估计现金流。',
 'cumulative_year_rule':'每年累计重置、1月缺原期与2021价格基期/样本权数更换标明；不计算跨期价格或累计额差，原下一公布跨年而同范围可报告原方向延续，但不作独立经济冲击。',
 'comparisons':['全79原身份的未条件化同范围经营基准','当前价格来源已知共同支持的未条件化基准',
    '删除价格条件后的既有非价格共同条件基准_全原范围','删除价格条件后的既有非价格共同条件基准_价格共同支持范围'],
 'counterexample_rule':'原A—H每个条件的每一个False经营结果全部保存，结果UNKNOWN单列；条件重叠不相加成独立次数，不选择有利条件/年份。',
 'episode_rule':'原列表中连续True且原范围相同才合并一已观察段；False为可见反对，UNKNOWN/范围变化仅为未确认边界，不证明新独立阶段。报告长度、左右可见/未知端、基金与问卷季度跨度及累计重叠。',
 'acceptance_boundary':'只接受可核对的历史方向/反例与延续来源解释；所有正条件率只为描述，既有非价格基准或少数连续段可以反对独立信息解读。不注册或接受金融候选，不把经营状态延续命名为股票预测成功。',
 'source_route_policy':'仅现有原件元数据/数量；E10976定位/60GET已结束，E1082020价格原因UNKNOWN路线不再查。',
 'budget':{'actual_local_continuity_experiments_max':1,'new_external_requests':0,'new_price_fields':0,'new_financial_candidates':0,
   'new_model_fits':0,'new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,'new_stock_labels_generated':0,
   'stock_labels_read':False,'new_full_accounts':0,'existing_source_code_edits':0,'parameter_searches':0},
 'E109_full_financial_source_gate_pass':False,'old_E100_E106_and_PMI_frozen_rejections_preserved':True,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,
 'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'prospective_forecasts':False,'orders_authorized':False}
write('protocol.json',protocol)
write('运行前git记录_E110.json',{'at':now,
 'branch':subprocess.check_output(['git','branch','--show-current'],text=True,encoding='utf-8').strip(),
 'HEAD':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,encoding='utf-8').strip(),
 'tracked_status':subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short','--untracked-files=no'],text=True,encoding='utf-8')})
print(json.dumps({'实验':'E110','状态':protocol['status'],'原共同状态':79,'原重叠条件':8,'自然更新':'下一原经营公布','实际实验预算':1,
 '外部请求预算':0,'股票标签预算':0,'模型预算':0,'源码编辑':0,'登记SHA256':sha(D/'protocol.json')},ensure_ascii=False))
